meta.name: turnstile-spin
meta.description: Set up, repair, or migrate to Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification in an existing frontend and backend, including server-side Siteverify.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网站加上人机验证,前端配置并连通后端校验。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站缺少人机验证,或现有验证服务频繁出问题。
copy.tagline_en: Add bot verification to your website and wire up the backend check.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site lacks bot protection or your current verification keeps failing.

howto.what: 把“设置 Turnstile”的请求变成端到端集成：检查 Cloudflare 认证、扫描代码库、创建 widget、在选定位置插入前端片段、在现有后端加上 siteverify 校验，并用真实校验通过后才报告成功。只改已有项目，不新建后端。
howto.when: 当你说到 “Turnstile”、“CAPTCHA”、“bot protection” 等关键词，或要求保护表单、端点等并阻止机器人/垃圾注册时触发。无关的 Cloudflare 任务不会触发。

say.text: 帮我的登录表单接入 Cloudflare Turnstile 验证。
say.note: 会自动扫描项目、创建 widget 并接线。

say.text: 把现有网站上的 reCAPTCHA 迁移到 Turnstile。
say.note: 会检测现有 CAPTCHA 并按迁移流程处理。

say.text: 我的联系表单 Turnstile 校验没生效，帮我修复。
say.note: 会检查认证、代码和 siteverify 调用。

howto.what_en: Turns a 'set up Turnstile' request into a working integration: checks Cloudflare auth, scans the codebase, creates the widget, embeds frontend snippets, adds server-side siteverify to the existing backend, and runs a real validation before reporting success. Works only on existing projects.
howto.when_en: Triggers on mentions of 'Turnstile', 'CAPTCHA', or 'bot protection', or when protecting a form/endpoint or stopping bot signups. Unrelated Cloudflare tasks are ignored.

say_en.text: Help me add Cloudflare Turnstile verification to my login form.
say_en.note: It will scan, create the widget, and wire it.

say_en.text: Migrate the reCAPTCHA on my site to Turnstile.
say_en.note: It detects the existing CAPTCHA and runs the migration flow.

say_en.text: My contact form's Turnstile check is broken, fix it.
say_en.note: It checks auth, code, and siteverify.
